_note: {t} = مس or أستاذ (Arabic), Miss or Sir (English). 'say' = the same line written the way it is spoken, used only for the voice.

omar.say_ar: {t}، بس تلاتة أكبر من اتنين! ليش التلت أصغر؟
omar.en: {t}, but 3 is bigger than 2! Why is 1/3 smaller?
omar.say_en: {t}, but three is bigger than two! Why is a third smaller?

sara.en: But why? That makes no sense!

khaled.en: {t}, when will I ever use this?

omar.ar: {t}، بس 5 أكبر من 2! يعني −5 أكبر، صح؟
omar.say_ar: {t}، بس خمسة أكبر من اتنين! يعني سالب خمسة أكبر، صح؟
omar.en: {t}, but 5 is bigger than 2! So -5 is bigger, right?
omar.say_en: {t}, but five is bigger than two! So minus five is bigger, right?

sara.en: But why? Minus always makes it smaller!

khaled.en: {t}, where would I even see negative numbers?

omar.en: {t}, plants eat from the soil, right?

sara.ar: بس ليش بتتنفس ثاني أكسيد الكربون؟
sara.en: But why do plants breathe in carbon dioxide?

khaled.en: {t}, why does this even matter to me?

bored.en: {t}, this is easy... can we do something harder?

lina.say_ar: امم... التلت؟ لأنه تلاتة أكبر من اتنين؟
lina.en: Um... a third? Because 3 is bigger than 2?

lina.ar: امم... بس الأعداد السالبة مش حقيقية، صح؟
lina.en: Um... but negative numbers aren't real, right?
